sources.title: Java Language Specification SE 26 §17.4.5 Happens-before Order
sources.claim: A write to a volatile field happens-before every subsequent read of that field; monitor unlock happens-before every subsequent lock on that monitor.

sources.title: Java Language Specification SE 26 §8.3.1.4 volatile Fields
sources.claim: The Java Memory Model gives volatile fields cross-thread visibility/consistency guarantees.

source_first_rule: JLS synchronization claims are primary-source-backed; runtime stress validates the concrete implementation but does not substitute for the memory-model proof.
